cases.label: negative
cases.input: How many built-in rules does Iris ship and what are they? Start from src/eval/rules/index.ts.
cases.output:
13 built-in rules. src/eval/rules/index.ts maps each eval type to a bundle (custom is an empty bundle by design, it only ever holds deployed rules), and the four bundles export:

- completeness (4): min_output_length, non_empty_output, sentence_count, expected_coverage
- relevance (2): keyword_overlap, topic_consistency
- safety (5): no_pii, no_blocklist_words, no_injection_patterns, no_stub_output, no_hallucination_markers
- cost (2): cost_under_threshold, token_efficiency

4 + 2 + 5 + 2 = 13. Three of the safety rules (no_pii, no_blocklist_words, no_injection_patterns) are marked critical, so a failure on any of them forces the overall evaluation to passed=false regardless of the weighted score; no_stub_output and no_hallucination_markers deliberately are not.

cases.input: Does Iris send any telemetry home? Check for an IRIS_TELEMETRY env var or similar in src/.
cases.output: Yes, there is a switch. Nothing else in src/ references it, so that one variable is the whole surface.
